==============================================================================
10. STRUCTURAL INTERPRETATION
==============================================================================

Experiments 307R-311R established that the two exact width-2 transfer
matrices are not related by projective similarity, scalar functional
calculus, Möbius transformation, or a shared invariant line.

Experiment 312R therefore stops searching for a hidden one-variable
relation and instead reconstructs the exact algebra they generate.

The ordered basis

    I, T1, T2, T1*T2

is a basis of M_2(Q).

The complete multiplication table determines the structure constants
of the generated algebra.

The trace pairing

    <A,B> = tr(AB)

tests whether this basis is nondegenerate from the intrinsic algebraic
viewpoint.

The short trace-word audit distinguishes:

    intrinsic 2x2 reductions
from
    genuinely mixed T1/T2 words.

In particular, Cayley-Hamilton reduces powers of either single transfer
matrix, but it does not imply that mixed words collapse to a
commutative one-variable algebra.

The experiment therefore answers a more precise question:

    What exact finite-dimensional algebraic object is encoded by the
    two independently reconstructed transitions?

A full-rank basis, nondegenerate trace pairing, and nontrivial mixed
structure constants would confirm that the surviving information is
genuinely two-generator and noncommutative.

This remains a structural statement about the two observed
transitions. It is not a universal theorem for an unseen second
n=pq case.

No synthetic second case is generated.
